outlook.statement: While near-term conditions in the cotton trade may remain uncertain, the medium and long-term outlook for cotton and textiles continues to be encouraging.
Our strategy remains centred on operational efficiency, diversification and measured expansion of our international business.
Looking ahead, your Company intends to deepen its presence in the markets it has entered during the year and to widen its agri-commodity exports alongside the core cotton business.
Increasing global and domestic demand for sustainable and traceable cotton products presents a strong growth opportunity.
Investing in environmental sustainability allows reduction of environmental impact and improvement of operational efficiency, enhancing long-term viability and brand reputation.
Plan to develop business continuity and disaster management plan in coming years
Propose to carry out human rights due-diligence assessment in near future

The outlook for Axita Cotton Limited is positive with a calibrated approach to growth. The Company operates in a sector where long-term fundamentals remain supportive, while short-term performance may continue to be influenced by cotton prices, crop conditions, international demand, foreign exchange, financing costs and geopolitical developments.
Core consolidation; improve business volumes and margins; strengthen procurement, inventory and receivables discipline; broaden domestic and export relationships.
Market and customer diversification; deepen value-added commodity opportunities; strengthen quality and supply-chain systems.
Selective scale expansion; process and technology improvements; commercially viable partnerships; prudent leverage.
Greater participation in the textile and commodity ecosystem; stronger focus on value addition, quality, sustainability and traceability.
Consolidate a diversified, scalable and resilient business model with stronger customer relationships and disciplined capital allocation.

risks: Cotton prices remained volatile through much of the year
Trading conditions across the sector were difficult
Occupational health and safety risks (financial losses, reduced productivity, reputational damage)
Product quality and safety risks (quality and safety claims)
Cybersecurity and data privacy risks (financial losses, legal penalties, brand trust damage)
Conventional cotton cultivation practices have higher environmental impact
Environmental risks from unsustainable cotton cultivation: excessive agrochemical use, water overextraction, soil degradation
Adverse health effects on farmers and communities
adverse weather, crop yields and raw-material availability
geopolitical tensions, tariffs and changes in trade policy
foreign-exchange fluctuations and export realisation risk
changes in tax, customs, export-control and other regulations
